comment: Findings of the plugin's layers and ports checks on the case suite, per case (F1 to F5 as [layer, l, b, r, t, information], boxes in um; ports as [check, cell, layer, l, b, r, t]). Written by tests/jobs/run_jobs.py --update-baseline (run_sweep.py --update-baseline). The negative controls' F1 to F4 lists are asserted empty in code, and the GAPS F1 positives, the cells Magic reads nothing in and cases.json's expect.ports are asserted there too; a case that fails one of them is never written here as it ran.
